one_liner: Two part-time jobs, 96 hours, pay stubs in hand — ready to submit

notice.title: Six-month renewal: verify your work hours

situation: 34-year-old working two part-time jobs: 64 hours a month stocking at a grocery store and 32 hours a month at a gas station. Data matching could not confirm the second job, so the state asked for proof. Has current pay stubs from both employers.
